julia-sales: Heads up	Client: Nimbus Health. Demo next Tues. They want enterprise commit guidance: steady 8 rps, short chat ~70% (<=64t), 30% long (>=1024t). Daily tokens ~2M. Peaks observed: 60 rps for ~8-12 minutes twice/day. SLO ask: 99p < 300ms for short flows. Any recommended reserved GPU layout + autoscale + prewarm plan? Also they want note for security questionnaire (KMS + private networking) to include in the presales doc.

omar-eng: Quick clarifying Qs: single region or multi? model family? and are long requests CPU-heavy (lots of decoding) or mostly prompt-heavy?

julia-sales: single region (us-west-2). They plan to use our redwood-mistral-7b-qlf for cost/perf. Longs are decoding-heavy (batch exports + analytics).

nina-se: my recommendation: reserve 2 x H100-80GB for baseline low-latency short chats and one additional reserved H100 pinned as a prewarm/large-job slot (so 3 reserved total). Then allow autoscale burst up to +3 on-demand GPUs for the 60 rps spikes. Prewarm slot handles KV prefix cache + large batch decode so short-chat latency stays low. Suggest KV cache for top 250 prefixes and an LRU eviction for others.

pete-infra: +1. Operational notes:
- Spread the 3 reserved GPUs across 2 AZs (2 in AZ-A, 1 in AZ-B) to survive AZ-level issues.
- Burst instances can be mixed (on-demand H100 + spot). If spot eviction occurs, route to quantized fallback model (mistral-7b-quant) with a throttled P99 guardband.
- Add health-check route that prefers reserved pool for requests with latency-sensitive tag.

omar-eng: throughput back-of-envelope: with batching tuned for short flows we see ~1500 tok/s per H100 for short requests. For long/decoding heavy jobs throughput down to ~600 tok/s effective. With token mix and 2 reserved H100 you cover baseline 8 rps plus continuous long jobs; 3rd reserved gives headroom for predictable nightly batches. Bursts -> +3 will cover the 60 rps transient.

nina-se: sample autoscale snippet to include in handoff (explain in text too):
```json
{
  "min_reserved_gpus": 3,
  "prewarm_indexers": 1,
  "scale_up_conds": ["rps>12","queue_depth>30","gpu_util>70"],
  "scale_up_step": 1,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 120,
  "max_burst_gpus": 3,
  "fallback_model": "mistral-7b-quant",
  "kv_preload": "top_250"
}
```
Make sure to call out that prewarm+indexer pins model weights and warms KV to avoid weight load + KV latency on demo day.

liz-pm: pricing / commitment questions: For a 12-month commit we can do an 18% uplift discount on GPU hourly vs on-demand and include 200 burst credits (each credit = 1 GPU-hour) as part of the package. We should also show a conservative scenario with 1.5x expected burst usage. Julia, confirm contract length they prefer.

julia-sales: they prefer 12 months with option to renew. Will confirm Wednesday.

quote-bot: rough math:
- Reserved: 3 GPUs * 24h * 30d = 2160 GPU-hours/month.
- Expected burst usage: 2 GPUs average during peaks for 6h/day -> 360h/month.
- Total estimate = 2520 GPU-hours/month.
- Apply 18% reserved discount for committed pricing. Final ARR depends on per-GPU-hour list price; will attach price sheet to the handoff.

pete-infra: security questionnaire notes to include in presales doc:
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for model artifact and KV encryption at rest.
- Networking: VPC peering + PrivateLink options available for Private deployment; dedicated control plane with audit logs for enterprise.
- Access: SSO (SAML) + per-route token scoping and audit trails.

nina-se: runbook for demo prep:
1) 48h before demo: schedule prewarm job to pin weights on reserved prewarm slot and preload KV top_250.
2) 24h before demo: run 10m smoke at 60 rps against canary route (quantized canary + primary) and capture 99p latency.
3) 2h before demo: ensure autoscale cooldowns are set to 120s and max_burst_gpus applied.
4) If spot burst used: enable fallback_model routing policy.

deploy-bot: Action created: prewarm-job-request for demo-nimbus scheduled when handoff doc is approved.

julia-sales: Great, I'll produce the presales handoff with: sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, pricing sketch, security Q answers, and the demo runbook. Tagging @liz-pm for pricing approval and @pete-infra for AZ/spot wording.

liz-pm: I'll review the price sketch today and add a conservative scenario plus an accelerated-growth scenario (2x bursts).

julia-sales: thanks team 44d will send draft to client and ask for their final token/burst confirmation by EOD Wed. end of thread.
